'''''To Sail Beyond the Sunset''''' is a book that [[Loial]] was reading when [[Rand]] woke up after [[Falme]].{{ref/book|2|49}}

== Parallels ==
"To sail beyond the sunset" is a line in Alfred Lord Tennyson's Ulysses. It is also the title of a book by Robert A. Heinlein, taken from the same source, but it is unlikely that Loial's book would be of that genre or content.
